mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever wondered if being a jack-of-all-trades might actually be the secret to real success? In a world where everyone seems to celebrate tunnel vision and early experts, it's easy to feel like you’re falling behind if you haven’t found your “one true calling” yet. But what if the winding path, the one full of twists, turns, and curiosity-driven detours, is actually the one that leads to unexpected heights? Together, we're about to step into the world of Range: Why Generalists Triumph in a Specialized World—an eye-opening book by David Epstein. Throughout this journey, you'll discover why dabbling, exploring, and connecting ideas across fields can spark creativity, adaptability, and lasting excellence. We’ll meet athletes, scientists, and entrepreneurs whose stories prove that sampling widely and refusing to settle on just one thing can unlock resilience and brilliance—even in the most competitive arenas. So, what does it really take to thrive in a world that's always changing? Let’s find out together.
